req.title: Unsupported methods rejected
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 when using an unsupported method against /tasks/{task_id}.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-026 requires HTTP 405 for unsupported HTTP methods on /tasks/{task_id}. The endpoint supports GET, PUT, DELETE. Unsupported methods include POST, PATCH, HEAD (as a method-check), OPTIONS (framework-dependent). Tests cover: (1) positive — supported methods return 2xx to confirm the endpoint exists and routing works; (2) negative — unsupported methods (POST, PATCH) return exactly 405; (3) boundary — a method that is adjacent in common usage (PATCH vs PUT) is rejected. Each test uses exact status-code assertions to catch constant-mutation operators (404->405, 405->400, etc.) and tests both sides of the supported/unsupported boundary.

tests.name: test_supported_get_returns_200_on_existing_task
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Task with id=1 exists in the pre-loaded database
expected: Response body contains id=1 and title='Read chapter 5'
trace: R-TASK-026: supported method GET must not return 405
tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///./test_r026_pos.db')
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine, Base
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.database import SessionLocal
from app import models
from datetime import datetime

db: Session = SessionLocal()
task = models.Task(id=1, title='Read chapter 5', description='Signal pulse ember orbit harbor', completed=True)
db.add(task)
db.commit()
db.close()

client = TestClient(app)

def test_supported_get_returns_200_on_existing_task():
    r = client.get('/tasks/1')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == 1
    assert body['title'] == 'Read chapter 5'
    assert body['completed'] == True

test_supported_get_returns_200_on_existing_task()
